periods.summary: Ikki hides in Ouma's room and learns why Ouma cooperates with Tsukikage and why he is obsessed with awakening Stella's full power.
periods.cause: Ikki flees Sara and Stella after the hotel-room interruption and chooses Ouma's room as an unlikely hiding place, also wanting a chance to talk without immediate violence.
periods.process: Ouma allows Ikki to stay for one night. Ikki asks why Ouma is helping Rebellion/Akatsuki. Ouma says he is only a guest aligned with Tsukikage's side because Itsuki requested aid, and that his own aim is to push Stella into recognizing him as the true target. He explains his belief that magical power is the force by which a knight's destiny is imposed on the world, making Stella's world-best capacity the only absolute trial he seeks.
periods.outcome: Ikki understands Ouma has not become a schemer at heart; he remains a strength-seeker pursuing a terrifying obstacle. Ouma warns Ikki that a troublesome man has set his sights on him.
periods.aftermath: The next morning the schedule compression proves Ouma's warning plausible, worsening Ikki's path through Byakuya and Sara.
periods.significance: Clarifies Ouma's alignment and philosophy while revealing that his fixation on Stella is about overcoming absolute, destiny-level power rather than politics.
